title: Bus 113 on Route 34 — SIS Roster Discrepancy

lines.text: EOC, this is Transportation Supervisor. Bus 113 on Route 34 has just arrived at the Fairgrounds Exhibit Hall. The SIS on board shows 34 students, but the 05:00 roster lists 32. One student, J. Alvarez, was not on the original list but is now present. The driver says he saw a student in a hallway at 07:30 and picked him up. Is the roster trustworthy? Can we confirm he’s not a duplicate?

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This inject confirms the 05:00 offline roster as the only trusted source. The CTO must verify the SIS was compromised via the Chromebook on Bus 113 (HUSD-CIRP-2026). Watch for the team to validate the student's presence using physical verification and confirm no duplicate entries exist.
